title: Optimal Last-Iterate Bounds for Nonexpansive Stochastic Approximation
abstract: arXiv:2611.13846v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We establish last-iterate mean-square residual bounds for nonexpansive stochastic approximation (SA), or stochastic Krasnoselskii-Mann (KM) iterations. In particular, we consider fixed-point mappings that are nonexpansive with respect to the Euclidean norm, and focus on polynomially decaying stepsizes. We study three conditions on the conditional second moment of the noise, and obtain bounds that are optimal up to logarithmic factors in each case. When it scales linearly with the squared residual, the best rate is $O(1/k^{1-\epsilon})$ for any $\epsilon>0$. In this case, for all considered stepsizes, our bounds match those of the noiseless KM iteration. When it is bounded by a constant, the best rate is $O(\log^2 k/\sqrt{k})$. When it scales affinely with the squared norm of the iterate, the best rate is $O(1/k^{1/2-\epsilon})$, and the mean-square residual can diverge if the stepsizes are not square-summable. translated_title: 非扩张随机逼近的最优末次迭代界
translated_abstract: 我们为非扩张随机逼近（SA），即随机 Krasnoselskii-Mann（KM）迭代，建立了末次迭代的均方残差界。特别地，我们考虑关于欧几里得范数非扩张的不动点映射，并重点关注多项式衰减的步长。我们研究了噪声条件二阶矩的三种情形，并在每种情形下都获得了在相差对数因子意义下最优的界。当噪声与残差平方呈线性关系时，最佳速率为任意 ε>0 情况下的 O(1/k^{1-ε})；在此情形下，对于所有考虑的步长，我们的界与无噪声 KM 迭代的界相匹配。当噪声被常数所界定时，最佳速率为 O(log² k/√k)。当噪声与迭代点的范数平方呈仿射关系时，最佳速率为 O(1/k^{1/2-ε})，且若步长不满足平方可和性，均方残差可能发散。因此，与压缩映射……（摘要原文在此处被截断）
tldr: 本文为非扩张随机逼近（随机KM迭代）建立了末次迭代均方残差界，在噪声条件二阶矩的三种情形下均给出相差对数因子内最优的收敛速率，并在噪声与残差平方呈线性关系时达到与无噪声KM迭代相同的界。
en_tdlr: This paper establishes last-iterate mean-square residual bounds for nonexpansive stochastic approximation (stochastic KM iterations) that are optimal up to logarithmic factors under three noise second-moment conditions, matching the noiseless KM iteration bounds when the noise scales linearly with the squared residual.
